name: Chicken and Cheese Casserole
description: A comforting chicken and rice casserole topped with a crunchy corn flake and celery mixture.
recipeIngredient: 1 can Campbell's cream of celery soup

recipeInstructions.text: Blend together the chicken, rice, cream soup, milk, cheese, and onion in a large bowl.
Put the mixture into a buttered casserole dish.
Stir the corn flake crumbs into melted butter, then mix in the chopped celery.
Cook until the celery is hot.
Spread the corn flake and celery mixture over the chicken mixture.
Bake in a 375°F oven for about ½ hour.

keywords: chicken casserole, cheesy rice bake, comfort food

_similar.name: Beef and Rice Casserole
_similar.description: A hearty casserole featuring ground beef, sautéed celery and onion, and cooked rice, all baked in a tomato soup sauce.

recipeInstructions.text: Sauté celery and onion in butter until soft and tender.
Place rice in a greased 1½ quart casserole dish.
Top the rice with the celery mixture.
Season the ground beef with salt and pepper, then cook in a skillet until browned.
Arrange the cooked beef on top of the celery mixture.
Combine the tomato soup with water and pour over the meat layer.
Bake in a preheated 325°F oven for ½ hour.

_similar.keywords: beef casserole, rice casserole, comfort food

_similar.name: Chicken and Broccoli
_similar.description: A creamy chicken and broccoli pasta bake with Parmesan cheese and mushroom soup.

recipeInstructions.text: Cook the small shells pasta according to package directions. Drain.
Add cooked broccoli, chopped chicken, cream of mushroom soup, milk, Parmesan cheese, and ground pepper to the cooked pasta.
Boil the mixture for 2 minutes to heat through and combine the sauce.
Serve hot with a cranberry salad.

_similar.keywords: chicken and broccoli, pasta bake, creamy chicken

_similar.name: Macaroni Casserole
_similar.description: A comforting macaroni and meat casserole topped with cheese and baked until golden.
recipeIngredient: 1 to 2 cups grated cheese (e.g., cheddar, mozzarella, Monterey Jack)

recipeInstructions.text: Cook the macaroni, drain and set aside.
Brown hamburger, adding onions, green pepper and mushrooms.
Add the spices, ketchup and tomatoes. Reduce heat and simmer.
Place the macaroni and meat mixture in a large casserole dish and mix.
Spoon the mushroom soup across the top, covering the casserole.
Sprinkle the cheese on top.
Cover and bake in 350°F oven for ½ hour.

_similar.keywords: macaroni casserole, cheesy pasta bake, comfort food

_similar.name: Mock Cabbage Rolls
_similar.description: A casserole-style dish mimicking cabbage rolls, featuring a savory ground beef and rice mixture layered over shredded cabbage and topped with cheddar cheese.

recipeInstructions.text: Brown hamburger with chopped onion, salt, pepper, mushrooms, seasoning salt, onion powder, and garlic salt in a skillet.
Add rice, tomatoes, and soup to the browned hamburger mixture; mix well.
Shred cabbage and place in the bottom of a large casserole dish.
Place the hamburger mixture on top of the cabbage layer.
Cover and bake in a preheated 350°F oven for 30 minutes.
Remove from oven, sprinkle cheddar cheese on top, cover, and return to oven for an additional 15 to 30 minutes, or until cabbage is cooked and cheese is melted.

_similar.keywords: mock cabbage rolls, casserole, cheesy cabbage

_similar.name: Cheese & Broccoli Soup
_similar.description: A creamy broccoli and cheese soup with a smooth texture.
recipeIngredient: 3 cups cooked broccoli (fresh or partially aged)

recipeInstructions.text: Melt butter in a large saucepan and cook onions until tender, but not brown.
Whisk in chicken broth and broccoli. Bring to a boil.
Add flour mixture and cook for 3 minutes.
Return to heat and simmer for 15 minutes, reducing heat. Do not boil.
Puree the mixture until smooth.
Heat with milk, cheese, and seasonings.

_similar.keywords: broccoli soup, cheese soup, creamy soup
